summary: Register Avito as the first dedicated classified provider with bounded listing, lead/chat, message and listing-stat projections plus sensitive text-message reply.

impacts.evidence: One tenant-bound connector Account resolves one numeric Avito user ID; callers cannot override tenant or account identity in classified requests.
Lead/message projections retain only bounded remote IDs, direction, text and timestamps. Access tokens remain callback-scoped and raw provider errors are not propagated.
Task 037 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP/OpenAPI operation.
Connector SDK v1 gains additive classified capability-specific projections/interfaces; frozen Connector and Runtime roots remain unchanged.
No migration is added; remote identities remain Task-010 mappings/configuration.
Fixed api.avito.ru authority, OAuth2 behind SecretAccessor, exact /accounts/self identity check, bounded bodies/cursors and normalized errors enforce the provider boundary.
All classified reads are read risk; classified.messages.reply is explicitly write_sensitive. Listing mutations are not admitted in Task 037.
Provider exposes bounded remote observations/receipts only; host application remains authoritative for audit and mapping evidence.
Read pagination is bounded. Message send has no qualified remote idempotency key, so ambiguous transport/5xx writes fail closed as write_outcome_unknown.
Outbound authority is api.avito.ru only. Webhook subscription is intentionally undeclared in this baseline.
429 and service failures are normalized with bounded retry guidance; Messenger 402 is exposed only as safe subscription_required.
Suspend/disable the Avito connector account to stop traffic; no schema rollback is needed.
Deterministic tests cover manifest/risk, exact account health, listing parsing and fail-closed ambiguous replies; provider Task-064 candidate passes all thirteen checks.
